purpose: Fresh-seed Solar H96 transfer test of the frozen relation-auxiliary-only MambaTSv3 candidate against complete strong baselines.
research_question: Does the relation-auxiliary-only candidate, selected without Solar test access, improve the former Solar fusion boundary while remaining competitive with seven strong baselines?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory matrix. Every job skips the test loader; no test metric, prediction, streaming metric, or test release may be generated or inspected.
claim_boundary: This matrix can update the Solar validation boundary only. It cannot establish held-out accuracy, universal superiority, independent causal benefit, or universal speed.

required_before_launch: verify Solar fingerprint and exact 24-job expansion
create one immutable source snapshot and fresh output root

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Architecture, lambda, baselines, data split, optimizer, scheduler, budget, normalization, and fresh seeds are fixed before launch; no Solar validation or held-out result may alter them.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share chronological split, M features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epochs, patience, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only MambaTSv3AutoCon receives the frozen train-only AutoCon objective with lambda=.001; prediction-connected fusion is disabled.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: DLinear, NLinear, RLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer, and Mamba2 receive no AutoCon, representation-fusion, ACF-memory, or candidate-only setting.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report all paired validation deltas, including failure against iTransformer if present; no held-out or causal claim.

stopping_rules: Do not promote Solar to held-out if candidate is more than 2% worse than its strongest baseline.
Do not retune fusion or lambda after this matrix.
Do not produce or inspect held-out artifacts.
prelaunch_gates: verify Solar fingerprint and exact 24-job expansion
